sloka: अनेन दुष्कृतेन त्वं मत्क्रोधकलुषीकृता ।मनुष्यलोकमास्थाय कञ्चित्कालं निवत्स्यसि ।। ७.५६.२४ ॥
transliteration: anena duṣkṛtena tvaṁ matkrodhakaluṣīkṛtā ।manuṣyalokamāsthāya kañcitkālaṁ nivatsyasi ।। 7.56.24 ॥

translations.english: Due to this misdeed, you, sullied by my wrath, will reside in the human world for some time.
